The FloPlast drain guard is a practical solution for protecting drainage systems from blockages. This robust black drain guard effectively covers existing drains, preventing leaves and debris from entering and causing potential damage or overflow. Manufactured from durable polypropylene, it offers a long-lasting barrier for properties, ensuring clear gutters and downpipes. It is suitable for both 68mm round and 65mm square downpipes, making it a versatile choice for a variety of setups.
